crossRefs.note: Of Gad: Eliasaph the son of Deuel.
On the sixth day, Eliasaph the son of Deuel, prince of the children of Gad,
and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year…
Eliasaph the son of Deuel was over the army of the tribe of the children of Gad.

people.name: Deuel
people.line: Father of Eliasaph, leader of the tribe of Gad

people.name: Eliasaph
people.line: Son of Deuel, leader of the tribe of Gad

people.name: Gad
people.line: Israelite tribe; descended from Gad, son of Jacob.

translations.web: “The tribe of Gad: the prince of the children of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel.
translations.bsb: Next will be the tribe of Gad. The leader of the Gadites is Eliasaph son of Deuel,
translations.kjv: Then the tribe of Gad: and the captain of the sons of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel.
translations.asv: And the tribe of Gad: and the prince of the children of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel.
